consumption_saving_2022_DHEA.source: 36-10-0587 Distributions of household economic accounts, income/consumption/saving, annual
consumption_saving_2022_DHEA.consumption_control_used: HFCE 1,511,381 (SNA household final consumption; conceptual match to SHS TC001 Total current consumption and to the model 'Amount spent on Consumption of Goods and Services'). NOT 'actual final consumption' (adds social transfers in kind) and NOT SHS TE001 (adds income tax/pension/gifts).
consumption_saving_2022_DHEA.saving_definition: Task 2: Saving = disposable income - consumption. Identity DI - HFCE = -9,039M (rate -0.6%). DHEA net saving +31,545M additionally includes change in pension entitlements (~+40.6B); not forced >= 0.

tenure_2022_CHS.source: 46-10-0083 Household characteristics, by tenure including first-time homebuyer status (Canadian Housing Survey)
tenure_2022_CHS.geo: Canada (provinces only) -- excludes the three territories
tenure_2022_CHS.statistic: Number of households (characteristic = Total, household type)
tenure_2022_CHS.universe: private households in Canada's 10 provinces; excludes residents of institutions, Canadian Forces in military camps, people on reserves/other Indigenous settlements, and collective dwellings (senior residences, work camps, religious communities)
tenure_2022_CHS.unit: household / dwelling (a household member owns vs rents the dwelling) -- matches the model tenure concept
tenure_2022_CHS.note: PRIMARY tenure calibration target (user decision 2026-08). Household-unit, base-year 2022, direct owner/renter identification. SFS 2023 rate is a donor-distribution diagnostic, NOT the target.
